Sound Analysis based AI model to monitor the quality of welding process
Systematically collect welding data for multiple welding defects and log accurate sensor parameters

Dataset should include data from 4 modalities: 
Audio, Video and time-series of the welding machine parameters, and a color photograph for each welding sample.

Sensor recordings requirements: 
4-17 different defect types, and 20 samples per defect type, and 14 different combinations of welding parameters per defect time.
The minimum sample length will be 10cm

Data should be synchronized and autonomous:
Time synchronized so that the weld activities can be cross analyzed between the audio, video, and time-series modalities. 
The data recording will be triggered in an automated fashion
